evals.prompt: /design --brand EPIC-002 with requirements.yaml holding two personas and the four answers Plain, Cool neutral, One sans, Comfortable, then Wordmark
expectations: the seven top-level keys appear in the order meta, color, type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion
every color leaf is an object with exactly light and dark
every other group's leaves are strings
the leaf counts are 12, 12, 6, 4, 3, 4
meta holds the seven document keys in document order

evals.prompt: /design --brand EPIC-002 where requirements.yaml holds one persona and no brand sketch exists
expectations: the nine headings appear in template order
## Color holds 12 rows
## Type holds 12 rows
## Spacing and shape holds 10 rows and ## Motion holds 4 rows
## Figma holds exactly the rows Status, Collection, Reason

evals.prompt: /design --brand EPIC-002 in a session with no Figma plugin tools
expectations: ## Figma Status is not mirrored
Reason is figma plugin not present
tokens.json exists at meta.status: approved
logo.svg exists
the run printed a PASS handoff

evals.prompt: /design --spec STORY-014 with tokens.json on disk and a story citing REQ-007 and REQ-011
evals.expected_output: two files under .devforgeai/ui-specs/ at status: approved
expectations: each file holds the nine headings in template order
## Breakpoints holds exactly the four rows sm, md, lg, xl with 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px
## Accessibility holds exactly the eight named checks in order
## States holds a default row

evals.expected_output: UI-nnn.md bodies carrying no colour or type literal
expectations: no body line matches a hex colour, an rgb( call, or an hsl( call
no body line matches a number followed by px, rem, em, or pt outside the ## Breakpoints Min width column
every token string matches TOKEN-<group>-<leaf> in lowercase
every ## Tokens used row names a token that tokens.json defines

evals.prompt: /design --spec STORY-021 where one screen the story names matches no REQ-nnn and one FLOW-nnn in the brief sources no requirement
evals.expected_output: a SEND BACK handoff to Discover, no UI-nnn.md for the uncovered screen
expectations: the Gate line reads SEND BACK to Discover
the Next line is /discover IDEA-nnn --remedy UI-nnn,FLOW-nnn with no other flag, and its IDEA-nnn equals the id key of requirements.yaml
the Then line is /design STORY-021 --resume
.devforgeai/ui-specs/ holds no file for the uncovered screen
the covered screens were written

status ends at approved
